children: RNS Number : 8862U  Morgan Sindall Group PLC  15 September 2026

Application has been made to the London Stock Exchange for the admission to trading on its Main Market of 35,000 Ordinary Shares of 5p each in the Company that may be issued by the Company in future under the Morgan Sindall Sharesave Plan (2018). Admission to trading is expected to become effective on 17 September 2026. When issued, the Ordinary Shares will rank pari passu in all respects with the existing Ordinary Shares of the Company
Lisa Minns, General Counsel & Company Secretary
